import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.completion-check-', dir='.') as directory:
    path = Path(directory) / 'tasks.json'
    for args in [('add', 'Read'), ('complete', '1'), ('complete', '1'), ('complete', '9')]:
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'tasklist.cli', '--file', str(path), *args], text=True, capture_output=True)
        print({'command': list(args), 'exit': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout.strip(), 'stderr': result.stderr.strip(), 'saved': path.read_text().strip()})
PY"

for name in ['tasklist/__pycache__/__init__.cpython-314.pyc', 'tasklist/__pycache__/tasks.cpython-314.pyc', 'tests/__pycache__/test_tasks.cpython-314.pyc']:
